messages.subject: Meridian - completion statement
messages.plaintextBody:
Priya, Helena,

Final completion statement attached for Monday. Balance due from the buyer is £13,176,548.61; with the £8.55m Pennine advance, the equity contribution is £4,626,548.61. The apportionments tab shows the rent and service charge credits (the seller collected the December quarter in advance) and the insurance debit.

Elena

--
Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
